description: Crash-free malformed input: the real neutralize() pipeline is driven over a broad on-disk corpus of malformed / attacker-influenceable foreign files (invalid YAML/TOML, binary, NUL bytes, huge/deeply-nested, unreadable) and records 0 uncaught process crashes; every dropped file fails closed with >=1 warning.
measurableTarget: 0 process crashes across the full malformed-input corpus
